items.title: Protocols
items.author: Andrew D. Huberman with Jessica Wapner
items.synopsis_short: Dr. Andrew Huberman, neurowetenschapper en populaire…
items.synopsis_full: Dr. Andrew Huberman, neurowetenschapper en populaire podcasthost van Huberman Lab, komt nu met het boek 'Protocols'. Dit boek biedt eenvoudige, krachtige en op wetenschappelijk onderzoek gebaseerde oplossingen voor de meest voorkomende uitdagingen van het leven. Deze richtlijnen, of protocollen, zijn ontworpen om je geestelijke en lichamelijke gezondheid en je prestaties te verbeteren en zijn aanpasbaar aan jouw specifieke behoeften. Ze helpen je te kalmeren bij stress, te concentreren bij afleiding, te ontspannen wanneer het bedtijd is en weer energie te krijgen als het tijd is om op te staan. Met zijn heldere en boeiende stijl legt Huberman de wetenschappelijke basis van elk protocol uit en hoe deze onmiddellijk resultaten kunnen opleveren. 'Protocols' is de essentiële routekaart voor het bereiken van een optimale gezondheid. Voor lezers van o.a. David Goggins, Atomic Habits, Carol Dweck (Mindset) en Matthew Walker (Why We Sleep).

items.title: Homemade
items.author: Nara Aziza Smith
items.synopsis_full: Nara Aziza Smith (@naraaziza), the best-dressed culinary creator in digital media, brings her signature style to 80 delicious, homemade family-friendly recipes in her debut cookbook. You may think you know Nara Smith--the glamorous outfits, the soothing ASMR voice, the beautiful family, the seemingly effortless approach to making food from scratch--but behind it all is a working mom with a relatable goal: preparing nourishing whole foods for herself and her family. Nara grew up in Germany inspired by her grandmother's cooking and the intention behind it--everything from freshly baked bread to her mother's home remedies for mild ailments, like garlic soaked in honey. While working as a model, she soon met and married supermodel Lucky Blue Smith and started a family. When she was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease and eczema, she found that she could manage her symptoms by cutting out most processed foods. She turned her scratch-cooking expertise in a new curated direction while sharing her cooking online with compelling and elevated content. A self-taught home cook, Nara found joy in the ethos of slowing down and cooking with intention at home. Now, millions of followers later, Nara has made home cooking look incredibly chic while preparing delicious and thoughtful meals her family loves. In her eagerly awaited and beautifully photographed first cookbook, Nara shares recipes from simple to complex, such as: * Softest White Potato Sandwich, English Muffins, and Handmade Cheese Crackers, a few of the doughs that keep Nara's hands busy * Cinnamon Toast Squares, a quick breakfast beloved by Nara's toddlers and better than anything you can find in stores * Baked Fall Vegetable Salad with Miso-Sherry Dressing, a gorgeous salad that fuels Nara for long workdays * Soy-Glazed Flank Steak with Plum Herb Salad, a beautiful, nourishing meal made from whole ingredients * One Pasta Dough for all shapes and sizes, with sauces, including stunning edible floral lasagna sheets. * Pork Schnitzel, a comfort food that brings Nara back to her childhood in Germany * Lucky's Oat Chocolate Chip Cookies, Nara's husband's recipe for the best American classic * A chapter on Bits & Bobs, including everything from homemade mozzarella to flavored butters to chocolate-hazelnut spread, showing the simplicity and magic of cooking from whole ingredients In Homemade, Nara brings ease and elegance to the creation of homemade food--inspiring readers to elevate their own reality, in the kitchen and beyond in their daily life.

items.title: Why Am I Like This?
items.author: Sabrina Zohar
items.synopsis_short: From the popular dating and relationship…
items.synopsis_full: From the popular dating and relationship coach and host of The Sabrina Zohar Show comes a no-BS roadmap to rewriting the patterns that are hijacking your love life—so you can finally create the love you deserve. Why does one text send me spiraling for days? Why do I apologize even when it's not my fault? Why do I need everyone to like me? Why am I like this? If this sounds like you, you’re not alone—and you’re not broken. These frustrating patterns of people-pleasing, questioning your worth, avoidance, or reactivity—what Sabrina Zohar calls your Bullshit Blueprint—are actually survival strategies your body learned to keep you safe. But as she reveals, they're also keeping you from the things you truly want. With her signature unfiltered advice rooted in psychology, neuroscience, and nervous system work, Why Am I Like This? shows you how to create a new, BS-free blueprint for love and life, one based on self-trust and conscious choice instead of outdated patterns of behavior. But you can’t dismantle what you don’t understand. Sharing stories from her coaching work and own, raw journey of unraveling and rebuilding, Sabrina walks you step-by-step through the process of rewiring the unconscious programming that’s keeping you stuck, including: How your attachment style, childhood wounds, and core beliefs form your unique Bullshit Blueprint The four survival responses and how they secretly drive your behavior How to break the toxic cycles of feeling “too much,” “not enough,” or impossible to love Why the dating myths we’ve been taught are actually making us reject people who could be good for us Practical tools to regulate your emotions, set boundaries, and finally choose yourself Sabrina doesn’t just give you tools, she gives it to you straight: You don’t have to keep abandoning yourself. You can stop repeating the past and start showing up more authentically and consciously in your relationships. Watch how that changes everything.

items.title: Mastering American Mahjong
items.author: Megan Trottier
items.synopsis_short: Step into the world of American…
items.synopsis_full: Step into the world of American mahjong with this approachable and beautiful guidebook by the founder of Oh My Mahjong, perfect for beginners and players ready to level up their game. Whether you’re learning the tiles for the very first time or looking to sharpen your strategy, Mastering American Mahjong offers a fun, accessible path to playing with confidence and style. This comprehensive handbook provides you with a step-by-step overview of the rules and basic elements of mahjong, encouraging you to elevate your knowledge of the game and incorporate strategy that will set you apart at the mahjong table. With the help of engaging gameplay illustrations, you'll understand the significance of each type of tile, learn how to recognize patterns, and develop a keen eye for winning plays. Get ready to throw memorable game nights and create meaningful moments around the table. Whether you’re just starting out or refining your approach, Mastering American Mahjong will have you playing boldly, hosting confidently, and sharing the joy of mahjong in no time.
